GitContentEnabled.title: Publish pages through Git
GitContentEnabled.description: When enabled, saving a page commits it to a work branch in the configured content repository and publishing opens and merges a pull request, instead of writing to blob storage directly. Requires the Git content connection to be configured on the server (PageBuilder:GitContent).
